match.pattern: ^update from cred:\s*payment for your\s+ICICI(?:\s+bank)?\s+credit card\s+[x*]{2,}[- ]?(?<mask>\d{2,4})\s+is due on\s+(?<due>[a-z]{3}\s+\d{1,2},\s+\d{4})\.\s*bill amount:\s*(?:rs\.?|inr|₹)\s*(?<tot>\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,2})?)(?![\d,])(?:\s|\.|$)

examples.body: Update from CRED: Payment for your ICICI Bank credit card XXXX-9876 is due on Nov 20, 2026. Bill amount: Rs.1200 Tap on the link to pay: https://example.invalid/pay
Update from CRED: Payment for your ICICI Bank credit card XXXX-9876 was paid on Nov 20, 2026. Bill amount: Rs.1200 Tap on the link to pay: https://example.invalid/pay
